title: calandrinia minima
intro: Calandrinia minima, commonly known as Red Maire or Pink Purslane, is a small, succulent plant native to the Mediterranean region. This plant is known for its edible stems and leaves, which are rich in nutrients and have been used for centuries in traditional medicine. Calandrinia minima has been used to treat various health issues, including inflammation, digestive problems, and skin conditions, thanks to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Calandrinia minima include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which contribute to its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
